verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio lets you export a team, set up/test an API endpoint, and run it in a Docker container (autogen-docs-17), which is a form of self-hosted deployment as an API, but there's no evidence of a first-party managed/cloud runtime (e.g., Azure-hosted service) for calling the agent as an endpoint. Missing for 10: managed hosting/runtime beyond local Docker export, scaling/ops guidance, and independent confirmation of the endpoint feature working in practice.
